title: Miami Bonefishing Charters

services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Capt. Mo specializes in Miami flats fishing charters light tackle sight fishing the flats of Miami’s Biscayne Bay for some of the world’s most challenging fish. This requires a Miami fishing captain that has knowledge, experience and patience as these fish provide very little room for error. Much of the fishing in Biscayne Bay while on a Miami inshore fishing charter consists of sight casting fish in shallow water. Most of the sigh casting is done in water from 12” to 6’ in depth when flats fishing Miami. In the very shallow water we will see the fish move about and disturb the water as their bodies are barely covered by water. When they feed in the very shallow water their tails will stick
